description: Implementation of ChargeDropdownReadPlatformService providing methods to retrieve various charge-related enumeration options for different contexts such as loans, savings, clients, and shares within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ChargeDropdownReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements methods to retrieve various charge enumeration options for dropdowns in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of charge calculation types applicable generally.

methods.name: retrieveApplicableToTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of charge applicability types, excluding invalid ones.

methods.name: retrieveCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of collection time types, excluding invalid and savings closure types.

methods.name: retrivePaymentModes
methods.description: Returns a list of payment modes (note the typo in method name).

methods.name: retrieveLoanCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of calculation types specific to loans.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of collection time types specific to loans.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of calculation types specific to savings.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of collection time types specific to savings.

methods.name: retrieveClientCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns calculation types applicable to clients.

methods.name: retrieveClientCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns collection time types applicable to clients.

methods.name: retrieveSharesCalculationTypes
methods.description: Returns calculation types applicable to shares.

methods.name: retrieveSharesCollectionTimeTypes
methods.description: Returns collection time types applicable to shares.
